title: Post-Remediation Chromium & Full E2E Re-Certification

RENDER_LAYOUT.note: Dashboard upload/button/sidebar/mobile-menu selectors failing; css-integrity responsive breakpoints timing out

TIMEOUT_INFRA.note: Modal-click, filter-clear, transaction-details clicks exceeding 15s actionTimeout

VISUAL_BASELINE_DRIFT.note: Expected post-fix — 20 baseline snapshots stale against current canonical build; require provenanced regeneration

OTHER.note: Mixed: NaN asserts, empty-state assertions, API-error-stub handling

C26-1_dashboard_financial_health_score.note: Backend returns financial_health_score as number|null. Frontend HealthScoreFooter now accepts nullable and renders '—' fallback. Seeded data: score=54.6 (non-null). Build type error resolved.

C26-2_transactions_envelope.note: /api/transactions returns {transactions:[...], total:N}. Transaction bank/category/amount fields render correctly. Nullability aligned with OpenAPI.

C26-3_reconciliation_path.note: /api/reconciliation (singular) -> 200. Legacy /api/reconciliations -> 404. Consumer corrected in C32, verified no deprecated consumers in browser network trace.

C26-4_wellness_score.note: Canonical /api/v1/behaviour/wellness-score reached (200). Legacy /api/behavior/score -> 404. useBehaviourCapability fixed to call canonical route. Response accepted by BehaviorScoreSchema. UI renders returned state.

fixes_applied_during_c33.change: Restored from HEAD — removed C30 mutation-injection prefix '//MUTATED\n' that corrupted the generated types.
Wrapped mutation apply + gate subprocess in try/finally so restoration is guaranteed even on gate-timeout/crash.
HealthScoreFooter prop changed from score:number to score:number|null|undefined; renders '—' fallback when score is null.
Zod bank tightened to z.string() (OpenAPI says non-null); hand-written Transaction.member/statement_file/subcategory made nullable to match OpenAPI.
Added null→undefined coercion at ViewModel-boundary for subcategory and evidence file_id.
Removed unused import mockBehaviorInsights that broke strict type-check build.
Endpoint drifted from non-existent /api/v1/behaviour to canonical /api/v1/behaviour/wellness-score; mapper now maps BehavioralScore→BehaviourViewModel.
BehaviorScoreSchema.score max(100)→max(10000) to match backend's basis-point contract.
Normalize bps score to 0-100 for ring/bar rendering: rawScore > 100 ? rawScore/100 : rawScore.

genuine_defects_discovered.description: Nine application pages (/statements,/imports,/recurring,/snapshots,/projections,/categories,/income-sources,/export,/audit) have no corresponding Next.js routes — return HTTP 404. Health-check spec expects them to exist.
Dashboard renders fail to expose required selectors (h1/h2/h3, main, upload button, sidebar aside) — suggests layout regression or missing ErrorBoundary wrap.
All 12 visual-regression snapshots mismatch because current dist differs from baseline captured against older code. Baseline requires provenanced regeneration.
Six action-timeout failures (modal click, filter clear, transaction detail open) suggest selector staleness or CSS z-index/rendering issues.

certification_scope_note: The canonical repository state 46ddb925 has been proven to function through the real backend/API/frontend/Chromium boundary for all four historical C26 contract classes (dashboard health-score nullability, transactions envelope, reconciliation singular path, wellness-score canonical route) with provenance-bound evidence and without weakening the verification system. However, 57 unexpected test failures remain attributable to pre-existing application defects (missing routes, layout regressions) and visual-baseline drift introduced by the certification-correct fixes applied herein. These are classified as C34 remediation candidates. The production build now succeeds from canonical source.
